units.ms: Per item: ms_unit 'fraction' (share of base MS) or 'flat'.
units.levels: Champion stats per level 1-15 before items and runes.
units.icon: Repository-relative path under assets/riot/; null when there is no icon.

abilities.name: Martial Poise
abilities.description: Moving during a basic attack makes Kalista dash a short distance once the spear is thrown; the dash grows with her boots. A started attack can't be cancelled. She chooses her Oathsworn ally at the start of the game.

abilities.name: Pierce
abilities.description: Throws a spear that deals 70/135/200/265 (+110% AD) physical damage. If it kills, the spear flies on and carries the target's Rend stacks to the next enemy. She can dash after casting.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.description: Passive: when Kalista and her Oathsworn (within 800 units) both hit the same target within 4 s, it takes 16/17/18/19% of its max health as bonus magic damage (once every 8 s per target). Active: sends a sentinel that patrols and reveals enemy champions for 4 s. Up to 2 charges, one every 45/40/35/30 s.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Basic attacks and Pierce leave spears in the target for 4 s. Activate to rip them out: 30/45/60/75 (+70% AD) physical damage for the first spear and 12/22/32/42 (+36/43/50/57% AD) for each extra one, slowing by 15/25/35/45% for 2 s. A kill resets the cooldown and refunds 12/18/24/30 mana. Epic monsters take 50%.

abilities.name: Fate's Call
abilities.description: Pulls her Oathsworn ally into stasis for up to 4 s. The ally can then launch toward a location, knocking up enemies for 1/1.5/2 s.

abilities.name: Draw a Bead
abilities.description: Her basic attack, Explosive Charge and Buster Shot range grows by 10 per level.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Gains 60/80/100/120% attack speed for 7 s.

abilities.name: Rocket Jump
abilities.description: Jumps to a location, dealing 80/120/160/200 (+80% bonus AD) (+50% AP) magic damage on landing and slowing by 50% for 2 s. The cooldown resets on a champion takedown or when a fully stacked Explosive Charge detonates on a champion.

abilities.name: Explosive Charge
abilities.description: Passive: enemies she kills with basic attacks explode for 60/90/120/150 (+25% AP) magic damage. Active: plants a bomb that explodes after 4 s for 80/110/140/170 (+120% bonus AD) (+50% AP) physical damage, with crit chance and crit damage at 50% effectiveness. Each basic attack or ability hit adds 25% damage, up to 4 stacks; at 4 stacks it explodes at once. Larger area on turrets.

abilities.name: Buster Shot
abilities.description: Fires a huge shell that deals 300/350/400 (+70% bonus AD) (+100% AP) magic damage and knocks the target back.

abilities.name: Deadly Venom
abilities.description: Basic attacks and Venom Cask poison enemies for 5 s, dealing true damage over time that grows with level (+3% AP per stack), up to 5 stacks. Monsters take 130%.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Becomes camouflaged for 8/9/10/11 s with 10% movement speed (20% while unseen). Leaving camouflage grants 35/40/45/50% attack speed for 6 s. Attacking or using a damaging ability ends it. The cooldown resets when a poisoned champion dies.

abilities.name: Venom Cask
abilities.description: Throws a cask that adds a Deadly Venom stack and leaves a puddle for 3 s that adds another stack every second and slows by 30/35/40/45% (+6% per 100 AP). Attack speed shortens the cast time.

abilities.name: Contaminate
abilities.description: Deals damage to nearby poisoned enemies: 30/40/50/60 physical damage, plus 20/25/30/35 (+35% bonus AD) physical and 35% AP magic damage per Deadly Venom stack. Damage from fully stacked targets spreads to nearby enemies and gives them full stacks. Monsters take 80%.

abilities.name: Spray and Pray
abilities.description: Gains 225 attack range and 30/45/60 AD for 6 s. Basic attacks pierce, dealing 15% less to each next enemy (minimum 40%).

editor_core.reason: After stacking poison and popping E, the Collector executes targets at around 5%.

abilities.name: League of Draven
abilities.description: Each unit killed and each Spinning Axe caught adds an Adoration stack. Killing a champion uses all stacks for 60 bonus gold plus 3 per stack. Dying loses half the stacks.

abilities.name: Spinning Axe
abilities.description: His next basic attack within 6 s deals 45/50/55/60 (+90/100/110/120% bonus AD) bonus physical damage and bounces the axe up; catching it readies another. Holds up to 2 axes.

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.description: Gains 25/30/35/40% attack speed for 3 s and 50/55/60/65% movement speed that fades over 1.5 s. Catching a Spinning Axe resets the cooldown.

abilities.name: Stand Aside
abilities.description: Throws his axes, dealing 75/120/165/210 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage, knocking enemies aside and slowing them by 25/30/35/40% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.description: Throws two giant axes that deal 200/300/400 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage, 5% less for each enemy hit (minimum 50%). They return after hitting a champion, on recast or at the map edge, with full damage again. Champions with less health than Draven's Adoration stacks are executed.

editor_core.reason: Catching an axe resets W, so Draven triggers Essence Reaver again and again. The Collector (executes) or Bloodthirster (sustain against poke) are the alternatives.

abilities.name: Icathian Surprise
abilities.description: After dying, Kog'Maw keeps moving for 4 s with movement speed rising from 10% to 50%, then explodes for true damage that grows with level.

abilities.name: Caustic Spittle
abilities.description: Spits acid that deals 90/150/210/270 (+65% AP) magic damage and lowers the target's armor and magic resist by 20/24/28/32% for 4 s.

abilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
abilities.description: For 8 s, gains 90/120/150/180 attack range and his basic attacks deal bonus magic damage equal to 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5% (+1% per 100 AP) of the target's max health (at most 100 against minions and monsters).

abilities.name: Void Ooze
abilities.description: Spits ooze that deals 80/130/180/230 (+55% AP) magic damage and leaves a trail for 3.5 s that slows by 45/50/55/60%.

abilities.name: Living Artillery
abilities.description: Passive: 10/20/30% attack speed. Active: an artillery strike that deals 80/120/160 (+75% bonus AD) (+25% AP) magic damage, up to 50% more against wounded targets; below 40% health it deals 160/240/320 (+150% bonus AD) (+50% AP) instead. Each cast within 8 s of the last costs 50 more mana (up to 500). Range grows with rank.

editor_core.reason: Kog'Maw plays around W: he fights while W is active, so his build is built around that skill.

abilities.name: Night Hunter
abilities.description: Gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions (more with level), and 70 during Final Hour.

abilities.name: Tumble
abilities.description: Rolls a short distance; her next basic attack deals 50/60/70/80% AD bonus physical damage. During Final Hour, Tumble also makes her invisible for 1 s. It can't cross walls.

abilities.name: Silver Bolts
abilities.description: Passive: every third hit in a row on the same target, by basic attack or ability, deals true damage equal to the greater of 6/7/8/9% of its max health or 50/65/80/95 (at most 200 against monsters). Active: gains 10/15/20/25% attack speed and 10% omnivamp for 3 s.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: Fires a bolt that deals 50/80/110/140 (+55% bonus AD) physical damage and knocks the target back. If it hits a wall, it deals 105/145/185/225 (+75% bonus AD) more physical damage and stuns for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Final Hour
abilities.description: Gains 30/40/50 AD for 8/10/12 s. When a champion she damaged dies within 3 s, the duration extends by 4 s (up to 8 s).

editor_core.reason: Guinsoo's Rageblade for the on-hit build; a crit build (likely Essence Reaver, with Q's short cooldown) is compared as a separate style.

abilities.name: Frost Shot
abilities.description: Basic attacks and damaging abilities slow by 20% for 2 s. Critical strikes slow by 40% (decaying) instead of dealing extra damage; her basic attacks gain bonus damage from crit chance and crit damage instead.

abilities.name: Ranger's Focus
abilities.description: Basic attacks build Focus (lasts 4 s). At 4 stacks, activate to gain 20/30/40/50% attack speed for 6 s while her basic attacks fire a flurry dealing 115/120/125/130% damage.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.description: Fires 5/7/9/11 arrows in a cone, dealing 70/110/150/190 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage. Each enemy takes damage from one arrow only. Applies Frost Shot's critical slow.

abilities.name: Hawkshot
abilities.description: Sends a hawk spirit that reveals its path. It reveals the area where it lands for 5 s, and units caught in the first burst stay revealed for 5 s. Deals no damage.

abilities.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
abilities.description: Fires a giant arrow that deals 200/350/500 (+40% AP) magic damage to the first champion hit and stuns it for 1.5-3.5 s (longer the farther it flew). Nearby enemies take damage too. Recast to steer the arrow.

editor_core.reason: Ashe has no mobility skill: Stormrazor's movement speed lets her dodge skillshots and escape. Yun Tal is also a good core.

abilities.name: Living Vengeance
abilities.description: A champion takedown grants 55% attack speed for 5 s (it can exceed the cap), plus bonus AD and AP based on his bonus attack speed. Other takedowns grant 20%.

abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
abilities.description: Charge up, then fire an arrow that deals 80/140/200/260 up to 120/210/300/390 physical damage (+110-165% bonus AD at rank 1), more with longer charge. Charging extends the range and slows Varus by 20%. Each enemy hit lowers the damage by 15% (minimum 33%).

abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
abilities.description: Passive: basic attacks deal 15/25/35/45 (+35% AP) bonus magic damage and apply Blight (6 s, up to 3 stacks). His other abilities burst the stacks for 3/3.5/4/4.5% (+1.2% per 100 AP) of the target's max health as magic damage each; on champions and epic monsters this lowers his basic ability cooldowns by 13% per stack. Active: his next Piercing Arrow deals bonus magic damage based on the target's missing health, more with charge.

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.description: Rains arrows that deal 70/115/160/205 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage. The area lasts 4 s, slowing by 25/30/35/40% and applying 40% Grievous Wounds.

abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
abilities.description: Fires a tendril that deals 150/250/350 (+80% AP) magic damage and roots the first champion hit for 2 s. The corruption spreads to nearby champions; rooted enemies gain 3 Blight stacks over 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Clean Cuts
abilities.description: After using an ability, her next 3 basic attacks pierce and leave feathers on the ground (up to 5 stored).

abilities.name: Double Daggers
abilities.description: Throws two daggers, each dealing 50/75/100/125 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage; enemies after the first take 50%.

abilities.name: Deadly Plumage
abilities.description: Gains 40/45/50/55% attack speed for 4 s, and her basic attacks deal 25% more damage. Hitting a champion grants 30% movement speed for 1.5 s. A nearby Rakan gets the buff too.

abilities.name: Bladecaller
abilities.description: Calls her feathers back; each deals 70/80/90/100 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage, with crit chance and crit damage at 50% effectiveness. Enemies hit by 3 feathers are rooted for 1.25 s. Minions take 50%.

abilities.name: Featherstorm
abilities.description: Leaps into the air, untargetable but able to move, then throws a fan of daggers that deals 150/250/350 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and leaves a line of feathers.

editor_core.reason: Yun Tal is a good core; a Conqueror + Essence Reaver first build is being compared for burst.

abilities.name: Daredevil Impulse
abilities.description: Hitting champions with a different attack or ability than the last raises her Style from E to S (6 grades), each giving 3% movement speed. Melee-range basic attacks and abilities deal bonus magic damage that grows with the target's missing health. Basic attacks on immobilized enemies dash her to them and keep airborne targets up for at least 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Flair
abilities.description: Fires a shot, or slashes in a cone at melee range, dealing 15/20/25/30 (+125% AD) physical damage; critical strikes deal 50% more. Cast during Wild Rush to hit every enemy along the path.

abilities.name: Blade Whirl
abilities.description: Spins for 0.75 s, hitting nearby enemies twice for 20/40/60/80 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage each and destroying enemy missiles.

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.description: Dashes through an enemy or structure, dealing 45/60/75/90 (+20% bonus AD) magic damage, and gains 25/30/35/40% attack speed for 3 s. Takedowns reset the cooldown. Tap Flair mid-dash to cast it.

abilities.name: Inferno Trigger
abilities.description: Usable only at S Style. Fires 10 shots over about 2.2 s at up to 5 nearby enemies, each dealing 20/40/60 (+50% AD) physical damage. Every shot can crit. She moves 30% slower while firing. Minions take 25%.

editor_core.reason: Samira's burst has to one-shot, and with her ultimate every enemy that drops to 5% is executed.

abilities.name: Love Tap
abilities.description: Basic attacks on champions and epic monsters build Love Tap stacks. At 3 stacks her attack deals bonus physical damage (15 + 40% bonus AD, more with crit chance) and the target takes 6% more damage from her.

abilities.name: Double Up
abilities.description: Fires a shot that bounces to a second enemy, dealing 60/90/120/150 (+110% AD) (+35% AP) physical damage to each and applying on-hit effects to both. The second hit can crit for 60% of her crit damage.

abilities.name: Strut
abilities.description: Passive: after 4 s without taking damage she gains 35 movement speed, and 70/80/90/100 after 3 more seconds. Active: full Strut speed and 45/60/75/90% attack speed for 4 s. Basic attacks on targets with full Love Tap stacks lower its cooldown by 2 s.

abilities.name: Make It Rain
abilities.description: Rains bullets on an area for 2 s, dealing 15/20/25/30 (+10/11/12/13% AP) magic damage every 0.25 s and slowing by 40% (more with AP).

abilities.name: Bullet Time
abilities.description: Channels for 3 s, firing 12/14/16 waves of bullets in a cone. Each wave deals 20/30/40 (+60% AD) (+20% AP) physical damage and can crit for 130% (crit damage counts at 30%). Recast to stop.

abilities.name: Vow of the First Lands
abilities.description: Critical strikes deal 8% (+8% per 100 AP) bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Cultivation of Spirit
abilities.description: Passive: basic attacks deal 10/15/20/25 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage and build Unleash stacks (2 on champions, 1 otherwise; 6 s, up to 6). Active, with full stacks: gains 25/35/45/55% attack speed for 5 s, and her basic attacks splash 30% AD physical damage to nearby enemies. Always active during Transcend One's Self.

abilities.name: Arc of Judgment
abilities.description: Fires a rolling arc that deals 60/110/160/210 (+85% bonus AD) (+50% AP) magic damage, then 8/14/20/26 (+12% bonus AD) (+7.5% AP) magic damage every 0.25 s while it lingers, slowing by 99% (fading over 1.5 s). During Transcend One's Self it becomes Arc of Ruin: 160/320/480 (+120% bonus AD) (+75% AP) magic damage.

abilities.name: Kanmei's Steps
abilities.description: Gains 30/35/40/45% movement speed for 1.5 s (45/52.5/60/67.5% toward visible nearby enemy champions). During Transcend One's Self it becomes a dash.

abilities.name: Transcend One's Self
abilities.description: Enters an empowered state for 15 s: her basic abilities cost no mana and Cultivation of Spirit stays active. Entering and leaving cut Arc of Judgment's remaining cooldown by 20% and reset Kanmei's Steps.

editor_core.reason: Yun Tal first (Stormrazor can replace it), then Infinity Edge and Lord Dominik's Regards in almost every build: Yunara needs crit.

abilities.name: Second Skin
abilities.description: Basic attacks and Void Seeker apply Plasma (4 s, up to 5 stacks) and deal bonus magic damage that grows with level, AP and the stacks already on the target. The 5th stack detonates for 15% of the target's missing health as magic damage (more with AP). Each completed item evolves one of her abilities.

abilities.name: Icathian Rain
abilities.description: Fires 6 missiles (12 when evolved) split between nearby enemies, each dealing 40/60/80/100 (+50% bonus AD) (+30% AP) physical damage. Extra missiles on the same champion or monster deal 25%. Monsters take 50%; minions below 35% health take 150%.

abilities.name: Void Seeker
abilities.description: Fires a long-range blast that deals 30/60/90/120 (+130% AD) (+50% AP) magic damage, applies 2 Plasma stacks and reveals the target. Evolved: applies 3 stacks and refunds 70% of the cooldown on a champion hit.

abilities.name: Supercharge
abilities.description: Charges up while moving 50/55/60/65% faster (more with attack speed), then gains 40/50/60/70% attack speed for 4 s. Evolved: invisible while charging. Basic attacks lower the cooldown by 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Killer Instinct
abilities.description: Dashes near an enemy champion marked with Plasma and gains a 100/125/150 (+80/120/160% AD) (+100% AP) shield for 2 s.

editor_core.reason: Guinsoo's Rageblade for the on-hit build; an AP build will be compared once AP items are in the database.

abilities.name: Hextech Munitions
abilities.description: Basic attacks and Spellblade hits deal 16% bonus true damage. After 6 Missile Barrage hits on champions, The Package appears; picking it up grants 4 Big One missiles. The Package disappears after 15 s.

abilities.name: Phosphorus Bomb
abilities.description: Fires a bomb that deals 60/120/180/240 (+110% bonus AD) (+100% AP) magic damage and reveals the area.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.description: Dashes, leaving a trail that burns for 2.5 s and deals 60/100/140/180 (+60% bonus AD) (+60% AP) magic damage per second.

abilities.name: Gatling Gun
abilities.description: Fires automatically at the nearest enemy for 4 s, dealing 20/35/50/65 (+55% bonus AD) physical damage per second and lowering armor and magic resist by up to 12/14/16/18 for 2 s.

abilities.name: Missile Barrage
abilities.description: Fires a missile that deals 70/140/210 (+65% bonus AD) physical damage; every third is a Big One that deals 140/210/280 (+130% bonus AD). Holds up to 4 charges (16 s each). Basic attacks on champions shorten the charge time by 2 s, more with crit chance.

abilities.name: Lightslinger
abilities.description: After an ability, his next basic attack within 3.5 s fires twice; the second shot deals 40% damage (100% against minions), grows with level and applies on-hit effects and crits. Vigilance: after an ally heals or shields him, or a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks deal 20 (+10% AD) bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Light
abilities.description: Fires a beam through an enemy unit, dealing 75/125/175/225 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
abilities.description: Fires a shot that explodes in a cross, dealing 75/125/175/225 (+90% AP) magic damage and marking enemies for 6 s. Damaging a marked enemy gives Lucian 65/70/75/80 movement speed for 1 s. Allies hitting marked enemies trigger Vigilance.

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.description: Dashes a short distance. Lightslinger hits lower the cooldown by 1 s (2 s against champions).

abilities.name: The Culling
abilities.description: Fires a stream of shots for 3 s, each dealing 20/25/30 (+25% AD) (+15% AP) physical damage. Crit chance and crit damage add more shots. He can cast Relentless Pursuit during it; recast to stop. Minions take 200%.

editor_core.reason: Lucian's mobility stacks Stormrazor very fast. Essence Reaver is the alternative: his short cooldowns proc it often.

abilities.name: Dragon Practice
abilities.description: Hitting champions with abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath give stacks. Stacks add magic damage to his abilities: 30% of stacks to Q, 55% to W's explosion and 12% to each E missile.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
abilities.description: Breathes fire that deals 45/80/115/150 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage plus magic damage from stacks; it scales with crit chance and crit damage. A kill refunds 15 mana once per cast. Upgrades at 25 stacks (area damage), 100 (explosions behind the target, 50% damage each) and 175 (a 3 s true-damage burn that executes burning champions below 6.5% max health).

abilities.name: Achooo!
abilities.description: Sneezes a fireball that deals 65/85/105/125 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage and explodes on champions for 10/35/60/85 (+55% bonus AD) (+80% AP) physical damage plus magic damage from stacks, slowing by 35% for 1.5 s. Later explosions deal 75%. Minions and monsters take 130%.

abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
abilities.description: Flies for 1.25 s with 75% movement speed over terrain, firing 5 missiles (one more per 65 stacks) at the lowest-health nearby enemy, champions first. Each deals 15/20/25/30 (+30% AD) physical damage plus magic damage from stacks.

abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
abilities.description: Smolder's mother breathes fire from afar: 200/300/400 (+110% bonus AD) (+100% AP) physical damage at the edges, or 300/450/600 (+165% bonus AD) (+150% AP) in the center, where enemies are slowed by 40% for 2 s. If it hits Smolder, it heals him for 100/135/170 (+50% bonus AD) (+75% AP). Minions and monsters take 50%.

editor_core.reason: Smolder plays by spamming abilities and rarely auto attacks, so Muramana for now; AP items will be compared once they are in the database.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.description: Every 6th basic attack is a Headshot that deals bonus physical damage scaling with AD, crit chance and crit damage. Attacks on trapped or netted enemies are Headshots at double range. Attacks from brush count as two.

abilities.name: Piltover Peacemaker
abilities.description: Fires a piercing round dealing 50/100/150/200 (+125/145/165/185% AD) physical damage, 40% less after the first target. Trapped or netted enemies always take full damage.

abilities.name: Yordle Snap Trap
abilities.description: Places a trap that roots an enemy champion for 1.5 s and reveals it; her Headshot on that target deals 40/90/140/190 (+30% bonus AD) more physical damage. Traps last 30 s; up to 2/3/4/5 at once. A charge returns every 25/20/15/10 s.

abilities.name: 90 Caliber Net
abilities.description: Fires a net that deals 70/120/170/220 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows by 50% for 1 s, knocking Caitlyn back.

abilities.name: Ace in the Hole
abilities.description: Takes 1.5 s to line up a shot on a champion, then deals 250/450/650 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage. Crit chance and crit damage apply at 30% effectiveness. An enemy champion can block the shot. Range 1750/2250/2750.

editor_core.reason: Caitlyn has no mobility: Stormrazor's movement speed is a big plus.

abilities.name: Get Excited!
abilities.description: When a champion, epic monster or structure she damaged in the last 3 s dies, she gains 140% movement speed (fading), 25% attack speed that can exceed the cap, and 10% of her missing mana, for 6 s.

abilities.name: Switcheroo!
abilities.description: Swaps weapons. Minigun: basic attacks build up to 3 stacks of attack speed (2.5 s), up to 35/60/85/110% in total. Rocket launcher: basic attacks deal 112% damage in an area, gain 80/95/110/125 range and cost mana.

abilities.name: Zap!
abilities.description: Fires a shock blast that deals 10/80/150/220 (+160% AD) physical damage, reveals the target and slows by 30/40/50/60% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
abilities.description: Throws 3 traps that last 5 s. They explode on enemy champions for 70/140/210/280 (+100% AP) magic damage and root for 1.45/1.55/1.65/1.75 s, interrupting dashes.

abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
abilities.description: Fires a rocket across the map that grows stronger over its first second of flight: 25/35/45 (+12% bonus AD) up to 250/350/450 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage, plus 25/30/35% of the target's missing health. It explodes on the first champion hit; nearby enemies take 80%.

editor_core.reason: Yun Tal first and Runaan's Hurricane second. Stormrazor is an option when there is no peel and the enemy has assassins.

abilities.name: Rising Spell Force
abilities.description: Hitting an enemy with an ability grants 13% attack speed for 8 s, stacking up to 4 times.

abilities.name: Mystic Shot
abilities.description: Fires a bolt that deals 25/55/85/115 (+135% AD) (+30% AP) physical damage and applies on-hit effects. A hit lowers his ability cooldowns by 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Essence Flux
abilities.description: Fires an orb that sticks to a champion, epic monster or structure for 4 s. Hitting it with a basic attack or ability detonates it for 80/155/230/305 (+60% bonus AD) (+75/80/85/90% AP) magic damage and restores 60/70/80/90 mana.

abilities.name: Arcane Shift
abilities.description: Blinks, then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy (an Essence Flux target first), dealing 80/145/210/275 (+50% bonus AD) (+75% AP) magic damage.

abilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
abilities.description: Fires a wave of energy across the map, dealing 300/500/700 (+100% bonus AD) (+100% AP) magic damage. Minions and non-epic monsters take 50%.

editor_core.reason: Long Q and ultimate range with constant ability spam: Muramana with Trinity Force, then Serylda's Grudge and Blade of the Ruined King.

abilities.name: Living Battery
abilities.description: Her basic attack is a burst of 6 rounds dealing 20 (+102% AD) physical damage in total. Her attack speed is capped at 1.5; attack speed above the cap becomes bonus AD.

abilities.name: Electrocute!
abilities.description: Fires a bolt that deals 70/100/130/160 (+80% bonus AD) (+30/35/40/45% AP) magic damage and slows by 14/18/22/26% (fading over 1.5 s). A kill refunds half the cooldown and all the mana.

abilities.name: Ultrashock Laser
abilities.description: Fires a laser that deals 60/100/140/180 (+100% AD) (+50% AP) physical damage and slows by 30/35/40/45% for 2 s. If it hits a wall, a wider beam fires that always crits champions and monsters for 50% more.

abilities.name: Spark Surge
abilities.description: Dashes, vaulting terrain. Her next 3 basic attacks within 6 s pierce and deal 20/23/26/29 (+10% bonus AD) (+20% AP) bonus magic damage to the first target, up to double with crit chance, and 85/90/95/100% to the others. Hitting champions lowers the cooldown by 0.5 s (1.5 s on a crit).

abilities.name: Lightning Crash
abilities.description: Discharges for 150/225/300 (+60% bonus AD) (+100% AP) magic damage. Hitting a champion grants 10% movement speed and 30% attack speed (can exceed the cap) for 5 s; her attacks become fast triple shots that chain for 30% AD physical damage (50% more on crits). Hitting champions extends it and adds Overcharge stacks, each giving 0.5% movement speed.

editor_core.reason: Zeri's Q is an ability with a very short cooldown, so she triggers Essence Reaver constantly.

abilities.name: Whisper
abilities.description: Jhin's attack speed is fixed: he fires 4 shots, then reloads. Bonus attack speed and crit chance give him AD instead. His critical strikes deal 80% of normal crit damage. The 4th shot always crits and deals bonus physical damage equal to 11% of the target's missing health, more at higher levels. Critical strikes grant movement speed for 2 s.

abilities.name: Dancing Grenade
abilities.description: Throws a grenade that bounces between up to 4 enemies, dealing 45/80/115/150 (+35/45/55/65% AD) (+60% AP) physical damage. Each kill makes the next bounces deal 44% more.

abilities.name: Deadly Flourish
abilities.description: Fires a long-range shot that deals 60/100/140/180 (+40% AD) physical damage and stops at the first champion; minions and monsters along the way take 75%. Champions hit by Jhin, an ally or a trap in the last 4 s are rooted for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 s, and Jhin gains movement speed.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.description: Places an invisible trap that reveals and slows by 30%, then explodes for 20/100/180/260 (+120% AD) (+100% AP) magic damage. Killing a champion also leaves a trap. Non-champions and champions recently hit by another trap take 65%. A charge returns every 20/18/16/14 s.

abilities.name: Curtain Call
abilities.description: Channels 4 long-range shots that each deal 75/150/225 (+25% AD) physical damage, up to four times as much against low-health targets (3% more per 1% missing health). Shots stop at the first champion and slow by 80% for 1 s. The 4th shot crits for 200% and scales with crit damage.

editor_core.reason: Dark Harvest, the missing-health fourth shot and the Collector's execute together finish targets that would otherwise survive.

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
abilities.description: Damaging a champion with a basic attack or ability grants bonus movement speed that fades over 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
abilities.description: Throws a boomerang that deals 70/100/130/160 (+70% bonus AD) (+60% AP) physical damage on the way out and back. Crit chance and crit damage apply at 40% effectiveness. Non-champions take 75%. Attack speed shortens the cast time.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.description: For 4 s, gains 25/30/35/40% attack speed and her basic attacks bounce to nearby enemies for 30/35/40/45% AD physical damage; a bounce crits when the attack did. Minions take 70%; at most 2 bounces hit the same target.

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.description: Blocks the next enemy ability within 2 s. A block heals her for 65/70/75/80% AD (+50% AP) and triggers Fleet of Foot. If nothing is blocked, half the cooldown is refunded.

abilities.name: On the Hunt
abilities.description: For 8/10/12 s, gains 15/20/25% movement speed and her basic ability cooldowns are 20/25/30% shorter. Damaging champions adds Morale stacks (2 on a takedown), each giving 2/2.5/3 AD; 8 stacks refresh the duration.

editor_core.reason: Yun Tal is the core; Stormrazor is a utility option with a tank but no peeling support.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.description: Senna gains no AD from levels. She collects Mist from souls; each Mist gives 1.25 AD, and every 20 gives 15 range and 10% crit chance. 35% of crit chance above 100% becomes physical vamp. Hitting a champion twice in 4 s takes Mist from it and deals bonus physical damage equal to 1% of its current health (once per 6 s per target). Basic attacks deal 10 extra physical damage; her crits deal 90% damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Darkness
abilities.description: Fires a beam through a target that deals 50/80/110/140 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies and heals allies for 40/70/100/130 (+40% bonus AD) (+25% AP). Slows enemies by 15% (more with AD and AP) for 0.75/1/1.25/1.5 s. Applies on-hit effects to champions. Basic attacks lower the cooldown by 1 s.

abilities.name: Last Embrace
abilities.description: Sends a shadow that deals 90/155/220/285 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit. After 1 s, it and nearby enemies are rooted for 1.3/1.6/1.9/2.2 s.

abilities.name: Curse of the Black Mist
abilities.description: Becomes camouflaged in a spreading mist for 6/6.5/7/7.5 s. Allies who enter it are camouflaged; when they leave they become Wraiths with 20% movement speed, hidden while no enemy is near.

abilities.name: Dawning Shadow
abilities.description: Fires a beam across the map. Enemy champions in the center take 250/400/550 (+120% bonus AD) (+70% AP) physical damage and are marked with Mist; allied champions in the wider wave get a 120/160/200 (+50% AP) shield for 3 s, more with Mist.

editor_core.reason: Senna now pokes from long range with big single hits and repositions; with no dash, Stormrazor's movement speed is a big plus.

runes.name: First Strike
runes.tooltip: Initiating champion combat (or damaging within 0.25s of engaging) grants 10 gold and First Strike for 3s: deal 7% bonus true damage. Bonus gold: ranged 45%, melee 60% of bonus damage. Cooldown 20–13s (level scaling).

runes.name: Ice Overlord
runes.tooltip: Immobilizing a champion creates ice for 3s. Slow: (1% bonus HP + 15)%. Gain 35 + 75% bonus Armor/MR for 2.5s. Explosion deals 15–100 (level scaling) + 5% bonus HP magic damage. Cooldown 20s.

runes.name: Phase Rush
runes.tooltip: Hit a champion 3 times with attacks/abilities within 4s: gain movement speed and +10 Basic Ability Haste for 3s and reduce remaining basic ability cooldowns by 20%. Cooldown 21–7s.

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.tooltip: Ability damage launches a comet. Damage: 15–100 (level scaling) + 2 × total champion hits + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Cooldown 16–8s.

runes.name: Aery
runes.tooltip: Attacks/abilities send Aery. Damage: 15–70 (level scaling) + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Shield: 25–120 (level scaling) + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Cannot resend until Aery returns.

runes.name: Guardian
runes.tooltip: Guard nearby allies for 2.5s. On sufficient champion damage, shield both for 1.5s. Shield: 40–165 + 6% bonus HP + 15% AP. Cooldown 55–25s.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.tooltip: Every 3s in combat, next champion attack: 3.3% max HP bonus magic damage, heal 1.3% max HP, permanently +10 HP. Ranged effects reduced by 60%.

runes.name: Conqueror
runes.tooltip: Separate attacks/abilities grant Adaptive Force for 6s, max 6 stacks. Each stack: 3–5 bonus AD or 5–8 AP (level scaling). At full stacks: ranged 5% / melee 9% bonus Omnivamp.

runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.tooltip: At 100 Energy, next attack gains 40% AS, heals 15–110 + 15% bonus AD + 10% AP, and grants 20% MS for 1s. Champion hit restores 8% missing Mana/Energy.

runes.name: Lethal Tempo
runes.tooltip: Champion attacks grant AS for 6s, max 6 stacks. Ranged: +4.8% AS/stack. At max, attacks fire 6–20 adaptive damage (level scaling), increased 0.33% per 1% bonus AS.

runes.name: Empowerment
runes.tooltip: 3 consecutive champion hits deal 40–165 adaptive damage (level scaling) and amplify damage dealt by 8% until leaving combat. Cooldown 4s.

runes.name: Dark Harvest
runes.tooltip: Damaging a champion below 50% HP deals 35 + 11 per soul + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP adaptive damage and harvests a soul. Cooldown 20s; 1s after takedown.

runes.name: Brutal
runes.tooltip: Attacks deal 6 + 8% bonus AD bonus adaptive damage to champions.

runes.name: Triumph
runes.tooltip: Champion takedowns restore 10% missing Health and 10% max Mana/Energy and grant 35 Movement Speed for 2s.

runes.name: Battle Zeal
runes.tooltip: While in champion combat, gain 1.4% stacking basic ability damage amplification each second, up to 3 stacks.

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.tooltip: Below 60% own HP, attacks vs champions deal 5–11% bonus damage; maximum below 30% HP.

runes.name: Cut Down
runes.tooltip: Attacks deal 6.5% bonus damage to champions above 60% Health.

runes.name: Coup de Grace
runes.tooltip: Deal 8% bonus damage to champions below 40% Health.

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.tooltip: Gain 3% Attack Speed. Takedowns grant up to an additional 18% Attack Speed (21% total max). Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.tooltip: Takedowns grant Ability Haste, capped at 15. Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.tooltip: Gain 1% Omnivamp. Takedowns grant up to an additional 7% (8% total max). Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Eyeball Collection
runes.tooltip: Champion or epic monster takedown grants 1.5 AD, max 8 stacks (+12 AD).

runes.name: Hubris
runes.tooltip: Champion takedown grants 5 + champion kill count Adaptive Force for 30s.

runes.name: Tyrant
runes.tooltip: Against a champion below 50% HP, deal 20–70 (level scaling) + 6% bonus AD + 3% AP adaptive damage. Cooldown 10s.

runes.name: Chain Assault
runes.tooltip: Ability damage marks a target. Next 2 attacks/active abilities deal 12–38 (level scaling) + 3% bonus AD + 1.5% AP adaptive damage. Cooldown 15s.

runes.name: Sudden Impact
runes.tooltip: After dash/leap/blink/teleport/stealth, next attack/ability within 4s deals 10–65 true damage (level scaling). Cooldown 15s.

runes.name: Cheap Shot
runes.tooltip: Damage to a movement-impaired champion deals 10–45 true damage (level scaling). Cooldown 7s.

runes.name: Zombie Ward
runes.tooltip: Enemy ward takedowns spawn a Zombie Ward for 120s and grant 3 AD or 6 AP, max 5 stacks. Default: max stacks.

runes.name: Empowered Attack
runes.tooltip: Every 8s next champion attack deals 20–60 bonus adaptive damage (level scaling). Ranged champions deal 80% of this damage.

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.tooltip: Gain 10 out-of-combat Movement Speed. Champion/epic monster takedowns grant +2 OOC MS, max 5 stacks. Default: max stacks.

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.tooltip: Every 3 nearby enemy minions or 3 monsters killed permanently grants +3 max HP. At 30 stacks gain +3% Health. Default progression input: 60 stacks.

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.tooltip: After champion damage, current and next 3 champion attacks/abilities within 1.5s deal 30–60 (level scaling) less damage. Cooldown 40s.

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.tooltip: Gain 5 Health every 5s. After champion damage regenerate 3 + 1.5% missing Health over 5s. Doubled for melee.

runes.name: Perseverance
runes.tooltip: Gain 10% Tenacity. When immobilized gain 10–15 Armor and MR (level scaling) for 1.5s.

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.tooltip: Gain 5% amplification when healing or shielding. If target Health is below 40%, gain an additional 10% amplification.

runes.name: Nullifying Orb
runes.tooltip: Champion damage that drops you below 35% max HP grants a 60–180 (level scaling) shield for 4s. Cooldown 60s.

runes.name: Unshakeable
runes.tooltip: Gain 3% Armor/MR plus 2% per nearby enemy champion, max 3. At max nearby enemies also gain 20% Slow Resist. Default: 3 nearby enemies.

runes.name: Courage of the Colossus
runes.tooltip: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants a shield absorbing 25–45 (level scaling) + 1% max Health for 3s. Cooldown 18s.

runes.name: Font of Life
runes.tooltip: Attacks/abilities hitting a champion heal you and the lowest-health nearby ally. Ally: 1.5% max HP + 5% AP. You: 1% max HP + 5% AP. Cooldown 20s. Healing is 130% effective for melee. Does not trigger at full health/no ally.

runes.name: Demolish
runes.tooltip: Third attack against a turret deals bonus physical damage. Ranged: 50 + 20% max Health; melee: 85 + 28% max Health. Cooldown 30s.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.tooltip: At 6 minutes gain +2 AD; then every 3 minutes increases following the verified sequence 2 → 5 → 9 → 14 → 20 → 27… Exact continuation formula not supplied.

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.tooltip: While above 65% own Health, gain 2–20 AD (level scaling).

runes.name: Scorch
runes.tooltip: Ability hit deals 21–49 magic damage after 1s. Cooldown 8s.

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.tooltip: Ultimate damage/heal/shield +10%; AoE ultimate damage increase +5%. Champion takedown reduces remaining ultimate cooldown by 7%.

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.tooltip: Ability or empowered-attack champion hits permanently grant +30 max Mana, up to +300. Default: full +300.

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.tooltip: Level 1: +5 Ability Haste. Level 5: +5 more. Level 9: basic ability hit reduces ability cooldown time by 8%; this effect has 8s cooldown.

runes.name: Celerity
runes.tooltip: Gain 2% Movement Speed. All Movement Speed bonuses on you are increased by 7%.

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.tooltip: After using a summoner spell gain 10–40% Movement Speed (level scaling) for 3s.

runes.name: Ixtali Seedjar
runes.tooltip: After destroying a plant, gain a seed replacing your trinket for 60s. Seeds become obtainable 2 minutes after game start. Each plant has a unique 30s cooldown.

runes.name: Hexflash
runes.tooltip: While Flash is on cooldown, channel up to 2s to blink; distance depends on channel time. Cooldown 18s; becomes 6s when entering champion combat.

runes.name: Botanist
runes.tooltip: Destroying a plant grants 10 gold and empowers it. Honeyfruit healing +20%; Scryer's Bloom vision duration +20%; Blast Cone grants 40% Movement Speed for 2.5s after knockback.
